The '''OT-12 Hazmat Droid''' was a large, six-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A number of OT-12 Hazmat Droids were deployed to the toxic lakes of [[Camp Traken-4]].
